title: File:Community shares tradition, hospitality with station Marines 130327-M-EY704-023.jpg
author: Lance Cpl. Cory D. Polom
description: Marines, Sailors and their families enjoy a free dinner from the leaders of the local community during the Havelock Military Affairs Committee’s Pig Pickin at Hancock Marina March 27.
